card.name: Right after a company name, before 'maker of'
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a word like 'leading' or 'a' that follows a company name or describes a company, just before a noun such as manufacturer, maker or producer.

modes.label: After a company name
modes.description: A comma or period right after a company name, where a description of what it makes is likely to follow.
modes.example: EON Reality<<,>> Inc., maker of interactive visual content management

modes.label: Before 'manufacturer'
modes.description: An adjective or article in a phrase like 'a leading ...' that is about to be followed by manufacturer or producer.
modes.example: Maxwell Technologies, based in San Diego, California, is a<< leading>> manufacturer of ultra capacitors.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict words meaning manufacturer, provider or producer next.
card.plain: It fires when a company has just been named and the text is about to say what kind of maker or supplier it is.
